facts.fact: 车队在距 Browning 八小时车程的北达科他 Williston 的 Love’s 加油站停下，Nate 憋尿憋到极限。
facts.anchor: Nate’s back teeth were officially floating by the time Christian eased them into the Love’s in Williston, North Dakota—eight hours from Browning.

facts.fact: Mooch 的大儿子们同年相继去世、丈夫随后过量服药死亡、最小的儿子 Conrad 也在越野摩托事故中丧生——花车就是为他而做。
facts.anchor: The main thing Nate knew of her was that her two oldest sons had died in the same year, like dominoes falling over backwards, then her husband had overdosed not long after, and then her last son had kicked as well in the dirt bike accident she had memorialized with the Sundancer.

facts.fact: Christian 在当卡车司机前曾被南方教会学校开除，后来当卡车司机又被同行打伤。
facts.anchor: Nate half remembered that, before Christian became a trucker for fifteen years and ended up getting beat up bad by some other truckers, he’d been kicked out of the church-school he’d famously gotten into down south.

facts.fact: Seine、Mooch、Christian 一起跟着 Jack Gladstone 的磁带唱歌，转移了 Nate 的注意力，让他终于尿了出来。
facts.anchor: Nurse Seine’s big voice came in then, singing loud and proud with Jack Gladstone about these masters of the plains

facts.fact: War Party 磁带被覆盖：新画面是从小屋前那两只小鹿的视角拍的，Sebby 活生生站在木屋门口。
facts.anchor: It was Sebby, whole and alive, at the door of Benjamin Heavy Runner’s cabin.

facts.fact: 画面里 Nate 看见了自己——他当时脸上一片空白。
facts.anchor: then there was Nate, looking right at himself, his face so blank, so lost

facts.fact: 他伸手碰屏幕，指尖与屏幕之间迸出蓝色火花，电视短路烧毁。
facts.anchor: It was enough to arc a tiny blue spark between his finger and the screen, shorting the TV/VCR out with a pop followed by a slower fizzle

facts.fact: 屏幕最后的光点是橙色的——像远处一堆被点燃、呼唤猎人回家的柴火。
facts.anchor: Like a distant pile of brush pulled together and carefully lit, to call a hunter home.
